WITH counts_by_side AS (
  SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) as order_count
  FROM orders o
  INNER JOIN riskandmargin rm ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.dealedge
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_value
  FROM counts_by_side
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT cbs.order_count, cbs.order_count - ac.avg_value as excess
  FROM counts_by_side cbs
  CROSS JOIN avg_count ac
  WHERE cbs.order_count > ac.avg_value
)
SELECT 
  SUM(order_count) as sum_of_counts,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM above_avg
